title: Make Zedu appear in google searches
description: If I just search on Google for Zedu, Zedu.chat doesn't come up. All I see is the link to download Zedu on the Play Store and App Store, and that is very bad SEO. Zedu.chat does not pop up there, so Zedu.chat should come up when I search Zedu. Also, there's a competing domain, Zedu.io, that does something different, so people, our customers, shouldn't mismatch the two.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Create a referenced Wikidata item for Zedu so Google can tell it apart from zedu.io
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Google's Knowledge Graph and AI answers lean on Wikidata to tell same-name entities apart. Approach: check whether Zedu already has a Wikidata item; if not, create one with official website zedu.chat, instance of (software / business), country Nigeria, inception, the App Store and Google Play app IDs, and official X and LinkedIn IDs, each backed by a published reference (press coverage or the store listings). If Zedu doesn't yet meet Wikidata's notability rules, list exactly which references are missing instead of creating a weak item that gets deleted. Done: the item link (or the gap list) and a recheck of the "Zedu" results 3 weeks later.
